question: What has been declared to the addressee concerning the practice of the soul?
premises: This practice of the soul has been told to you.
The statement is addressed to Bhairavī.
inference: The practice of the soul has been declared to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: The details of that practice are not repeated in this verse.
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
